findings.title: Court correction roundtrip changes its frame scope
findings.suggested_fix: Store iOS court corrections by frame index and resolve applicable corrections within the same scene for inference, cached review and export. Add a nonzero-frame, multi-scene cross-platform roundtrip test.
findings.first_evidence: ios/TennisApp/TennisApp.swift:154: func saveCourt() { perform { _=try Court(points:corners); guard let store else { throw PackageError.invalid("请先开始分析以建立记录") }; var c=try store.corrections(); c.court[String(frame?.scene ?? 0)]=corners; try store.saveCorrections(c); calibrating=false } }

residual_risks: Covered all five supplied risk divisions through representative paths.
Native smoke bypasses SwiftUI lifecycle and file-picker behavior; VALIDATION.md accurately discloses this.
Termination after the complete SQLite checkpoint but before artifact export leaves stale JSON until explicit export.
Swift Corrections drops desktop corrections.events metadata during import/re-export; immediate events.json state survives, but regeneration portability needs verification.
testing_gaps: Read-only source review; no native runtime tests executed.
Simulator fixture does not exercise pause/resume, scene changes or nonzero-frame court corrections.
